# Life Manager Cloud: One Proactive Manager for Work, Money, Calendar, Body and Mind

Life Manager is being built as one proactive manager for your whole life: work, money, everyday responsibilities, body, and mind. It chooses useful priorities, carries work forward, and verifies outcomes — without a daily prompt. Calendar travel-time planning is one workflow, not the product.

## One manager, not another calendar app

Life Manager is being built as one proactive manager for your whole life: work, money, everyday responsibilities, body, and mind. It chooses useful priorities, carries work forward, and verifies outcomes — without a daily prompt. Calendar travel-time planning is one workflow, not the product.

## Two ways to run it

Run the same open-source core on your own computer, or use Life Manager Cloud, the hosted mode that runs continuously on a dedicated Maritime VM and reports verified progress to your sign-in email.

## What signup does — and does not — require

Start with Google identity only. Signup does not require Calendar or Gmail inbox access, a task prompt, goals, budget, or payout details. Provider-specific identity verification, account connections, and interviews may still require your involvement.

## Pricing

Life Manager Cloud is $29/month after a 7-day free trial. Billing is set up in the web app after Calendar setup; no payment details are required at signup. Price on the site: 29 USD.

## Earning workflows — stated honestly

The first Cloud earning workflow is being connected to Capafy. Capafy requires Publisher Certification and publisher confirmation of selected Skills and configuration before each Agent version can go live. Life Manager reports listings and earnings only after Capafy confirms them. The complete Cloud-to-Capafy path is still being verified, and earnings are not guaranteed.

## Start from the product page

If one manager for work, money, calendar, body and mind sounds useful, start from the product page, where the price, the trial, and the sign-up requirements are stated plainly:

- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm
- Life Manager Cloud, hosted on Maritime: https://aniccaai.com/maritime

One manager for your whole life.
